_comment: 生成物，别手改。scripts/export-codex.ts 从 data/vanilla/units、unit-texts.json 与 vanilla-assets.json 生成。

desc.zh: 踏云而行的远东风暴瑞兽，独角贯雷、铁蹄生霆，以神速撕裂敌阵的魔法巨兽。
desc.en: An auspicious storm-beast walking on clouds, its horn threaded with lightning and hooves thundering, tearing through enemy lines with unnatural speed.

story.zh: 麒麟是“风与土结合而生”的风暴精怪。天风的暴烈与大地的沉稳在最纯粹的交汇处凝形，化作一身龙鳞、独角如刃、流云为鬃的神兽。它们踏云而行，不践一草一木；振鬃之际，雷霆自角端游走。震旦天庭视其为与龙马同为一系的风暴灵兽，尼朋则视其为现身预兆太平的瑞兽——唯有正气之地能孕育，唯有正义之师肯相从。
story.en: The Kirin is a storm spirit "born of the union of wind and earth". Where the fury of heaven's wind and the steadfastness of the land meet in their purest conjunction, these spirits take shape: divine beasts clad in dragon scales, single horns keen as blades, streaming clouds for manes. They walk upon the clouds and trample no grass or tree; and when they toss their manes, thunder runs from the very tips of their horns. The Celestial Court of Cathay counts them storm-spirits of one kindred with the Longma, while Nippon hails them as auspicious beasts whose coming presages peace: only lands of virtue can bring them forth, and only righteous hosts will they follow.

desc.zh: 麒麟振鬃而鸣，天雷循其角端回应，轰击近旁敌阵。
desc.en: The Kirin tosses its mane and roars, and heaven's thunder answers at the tip of its horn, crashing down upon the enemy ranks nearby.

desc.zh: 战争罗盘从天堂引来致命的闪电，将敌人烧成灰烬
desc.en: The War Compass funnels deadly electricity from the heavens to sear and burn and smite the foe.

desc.zh: 这支部队可以对所有敌军部队引发恐惧，令附近敌军遭受领导力惩罚。同时这支部队自身也对恐惧效果免疫。恐惧惩罚不能叠加
desc.en: This unit frightens all enemy units, reducing their leadership when nearby. It is also immune to fear. Fear penalties do not stack.

desc.zh: 这支部队可惊骇敌军，令其近战目标溃逃一段时间。对于能够造成惊骇的部队来说，其自身也将免疫恐惧与惊骇效果
desc.en: This unit can cause terror, making its melee target rout for a short time. Units that cause terror are immune to terror and fear themselves.

desc.zh: 纵使执行的是最令人筋疲力尽的行动，这支部队也永远不会损失体力
desc.en: Even when performing the most fatiguing actions, this unit never loses vigour.

desc.zh: 这支部队免疫心理攻击（恐惧与惊骇）
desc.en: The unit is immune to psychological attacks (Fear & Terror).

desc.zh: 这支部队不受因地形导致的速度与战斗惩罚
desc.en: Speed and combat penalties caused by terrain are ignored by this unit.
